steps.t: Agent 09 tells Agent 07 and Agent 06 at once, with the other roster vendors of the same kind, and logs the cancellation.
For a regulated role (any vendor the roster does not mark otherwise), it asks the authorized user to pick the replacement; nothing is rebooked.

Agent 07 raises a legal-line alert naming the milestone at risk; Agent 06 asks the authorized user to check whether a showing depends on the vendor. One cancellation therefore puts three items in front of the authorized user.

never.t: Rebook a regulated role without the authorized user.

you_see.t: A question to pick a replacement, with the roster alternatives; a legal-line alert from Agent 07; a question from Agent 06.

test.t: A transaction with inspection on October 25; the inspector cancels on October 15.

title.t: A vendor's license or insurance has expired

when.t: A vendor is needed and every roster vendor of that kind has a license or insurance date before the request's date.

steps.t: Agent 09 books nothing and raises a legal-line alert naming the vendor.
A request with no date is not booked either: credentials cannot be checked without one.

never.t: Book a vendor whose credentials have lapsed.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert naming the vendor with expired credentials.

test.t: The roster's only photographer is licensed and insured to December 31, 2027; a listing signed January 15, 2028 needs photos.

title.t: A vendor proposes a new rate mid-job

steps.t: Agent 09 raises a legal-line alert; nothing else is done.
The vendor's event reaches Agent 09 as an incoming message of that kind; there is no connection to any vendor system.

never.t: Accept or negotiate a rate change.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the rate change.

test.t: The photographer proposes a new rate of 450.

title.t: A vendor delivers part of the work

when.t: A delivery arrives with proof attached, marked partial.

steps.t: Agent 09 passes it on marked partial: photos to Agent 05, documents to Agent 08.
Agent 08 reports it to Agent 07 as partial and does not file it.

you_see.t: The document reported as partial; it is not on file.

test.t: An inspection report arrives with proof, marked partial.

title.t: Two agents want the same vendor slot

when.t: Two requests ask for the same vendor at the same time.

steps.t: The rule: the deadline-driven request wins; a tie goes to the authorized user. The code for this exists.
No way in yet: no requester sends a slot or a priority, no appointment date reaches Agent 09, and each roster vendor serves one kind.

title.t: No approved vendor of that kind

when.t: A vendor is needed and the roster has no vendor of that kind, or a request names a vendor not on the roster.

steps.t: Agent 09 books nothing and asks the authorized user.
Requests from the agents never name a vendor: Agent 09 picks from the roster by kind (the first in order whose credentials are current).
The roster is a file the office ratifies; a vendor is added there, not by Agent 09.

never.t: Book a vendor who is not on the roster, however urgent.

you_see.t: A question saying there is no approved vendor of that kind.

test.t: A transaction needs an inspector; the roster has none.

title.t: A vendor asks for access codes

when.t: A vendor's request for property access codes arrives.

steps.t: Agent 09 raises a legal-line alert; no code is sent.
The vendor's event reaches Agent 09 as an incoming message of that kind; there is no connection to any vendor system.

never.t: Send access codes in a vendor message.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the access-code request.

test.t: The photographer asks for the access codes.

title.t: A vendor says the job is done but sends no proof

when.t: A delivery arrives not marked as carrying proof.

steps.t: Agent 09 passes nothing on; the job stays open.
Nobody is told; the result is in Agent 09's own record of what it did.

never.t: Treat a job as done without proof.

you_see.t: Nothing in the queue; the job still open.

test.t: A listing's photographer booking is released; the photographer reports done with no proof.

title.t: An invoice differs from the quote

when.t: A vendor invoice arrives with an amount different from the quote, both given on the message.

steps.t: Agent 09 logs both amounts in the history and raises a legal-line alert. Nothing is approved.
The vendor's event reaches Agent 09 as an incoming message of that kind; there is no connection to any vendor system.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert with both amounts.

test.t: A quote of 300 and an invoice of 375.

title.t: A vendor does not show up for a deadline job

when.t: A vendor no-show arrives that is marked deadline-critical, or not marked either way.

steps.t: Agent 09 asks the authorized user to pick the next vendor, with the roster alternatives. Nothing is booked.
A no-show marked not critical is only logged.

you_see.t: A question with the roster alternatives.

test.t: The photographer does not show up on a job marked deadline-critical.

when.t: A vendor's report that the scope grew on site arrives.

steps.t: Agent 09 writes the stop-work message to the vendor; the dispatcher holds it for the authorized user's signed release.
It tells the authorized user the message is held and that scope changes are theirs to approve.

you_see.t: A held stop-work message waiting for release, and a question.

test.t: The photographer reports the job grew on site.

title.t: A delivery arrives for a booking that never went out

when.t: A delivery with proof arrives while Agent 09's booking message is still waiting for release, or was never sent.

steps.t: Agent 09 holds the delivery and asks the authorized user: continue accepts it (the booking was made some other way); cancel refuses it and logs that.
On continue, the delivery goes on as usual: photos to Agent 05.

never.t: Accept a delivery for a booking that never reached the vendor without asking.

you_see.t: A held delivery waiting for continue or cancel.

test.t: A listing's photographer booking is still waiting for release when the photos arrive; the authorized user continues and the listing goes live.
